# Repository Issue & PR Labels

| Label | Color | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something isn't working as expected |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | New feature or request |
| `documentation` | `#0075ca` | Improvements or additions to documentation |
| `triage` | `#d4c5f9` | Requires triage by maintainers |
| `core` | `#0052cc` | Changes to kernel core engine or UDM |
| `plugin` | `#bfd4f2` | Changes to plugin system or format descriptors |
| `cli` | `#5319e7` | Changes to command line interface |
| `dependencies` | `#0366d6` | Pull requests updating dependencies |
| `stale` | `#ffffff` | Issue or PR inactive for > 60 days |
